description: Puntos Wifi instalados en la provincia de Castellón is a dataset listed in Diputació de Castelló open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Puntos Wifi instalados en la provincia de Castellón Relación de los 474 puntos de acceso inhalambrico (Hotspot) Wifi 135, que están instalados en los 112 municipios de la provincia de Castellón. Clicando en la columna donde aparece el nombre se pueden ordenar alfabeticamente. Coverage: Province of Castellón. The portal files it under Science and technology. Its keywords are wifi, municipios, geolocalizado. The portal shows 475 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datosabiertos-dipcas-es-portal.
